question: Provide an example of a process in a computer system.
answerMd:
### Process-Based vs. Thread-Based Multitasking

| Comparison Parameter | Process-Based Multitasking | Thread-Based Multitasking |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Definition** | Concurrent execution of multiple distinct **programs** (processes). | Concurrent execution of multiple execution **paths** within the same program. |
| **Memory Space** | Each process has its own **separate, isolated address space**. | All threads in a process share the **same heap and memory**. |
| **Context Switch Overhead** | **Heavyweight:** Involves OS virtual memory page table swaps. | **Lightweight:** Minimal overhead (only register and stack swap). |
| **Inter-communication (IPC)** | Expensive; requires sockets, pipes, or shared OS memory. | Inexpensive; communicate directly via shared objects and `wait()`/`notify()`. |

$$\therefore \text{Threads are termed 'lightweight processes' because they execute within a shared memory context.}$$
